abstract: The Bretton Woods system is often described as freeing national monetary policies from the gold‐reserve constraints of the gold standard. Breaking the ‘gold fetters’ was essential to the embedded liberalism and economic interventionism of the post‐war era. Yet gold retained a crucial role: monetary authorities backed currency with gold reserves, both de facto and de jure, frequently maintaining gold cover ratios comparable to those of the gold standard. How, then, could gold backing coexist with autonomous domestic macroeconomic policy? This article shows that the combination of two phenomena provides an answer: credit growth and currency growth became increasingly decoupled after 1945, and central banks shifted their emphasis from money toward credit. This created substantial scope to stimulate domestic economic activity through credit expansion without being constrained by the link between gold and currency in circulation. Econometric analysis for 38 countries indicates that gold reserves remained strongly correlated with currency, but not with bank credit. Changes in credit markets and central bank instruments therefore allowed gold backing to persist largely as a symbolic tie, without constraining domestic policy. Gold, however, exerted pressure on US policy and shaped international monetary relations. These findings show that institutional persistence does not guarantee similar economic effects.
abstract_zh: 布雷顿森林体系常被描述为将国家货币政策从金本位的黄金储备约束中解放出来。打破“黄金枷锁”对于战后时代的嵌入式自由主义和经济干预主义至关重要。然而，黄金仍扮演着关键角色：货币当局以黄金储备为货币背书，无论事实上还是法律上，其黄金覆盖率往往与金本位时期相当。那么，黄金背书如何能与自主的国内宏观经济政策共存？本文表明，两种现象的结合提供了答案：1945年后，信贷增长与货币增长日益脱钩，且中央银行将重心从货币转向信贷。这为通过信贷扩张刺激国内经济活动创造了巨大空间，而不受黄金与流通货币之间联系的制约。对38个国家的计量经济学分析表明，黄金储备与货币仍高度相关，但与银行信贷无关。因此，信贷市场的变化及中央银行工具的调整，使得黄金背书在很大程度上作为一种象征性纽带得以延续，而未对国内政策形成约束。然而，黄金确实对美国政策施加了压力，并塑造了国际货币关系。这些发现表明，制度的持续性并不保证产生相似的经济效应。
title: Persistence in a changing world: Gold backing and monetary policy autonomy under Bretton Woods
title_zh: 变化世界中的持续性：布雷顿森林体系下的黄金支撑与货币政策自主性

abstract: We examine the colonial origins and evolution of gender inequality in mission schooling and formal labour force participation across six cities in British colonial Africa, using marriage register data for some 30,000 Anglican brides and grooms well‐positioned to benefit from colonial educational and employment opportunities. The spouses’ signature literacy and occupational statistics reveal growing gender gaps during the early colonial period, both in access to mission schools and formal work. The gender gap in formal work was much more extensive than that in schooling, peaking in the 1930s but then rapidly declining again, helped by the Africanisation and feminisation of the British colonial public service towards decolonization. Women's alternatives to formal labour differed markedly across urban British Africa, with the majority of West African brides engaging in informal income‐generating activities, in contrast to their East African peers, who were primarily devoted to homemaking. We attribute these regional differences to women's greater economic agency in precolonial West Africa, which persisted despite the Victorian gender ideals promoted by missionaries.
abstract_zh: 我们利用约三万名英国殖民时期非洲六座城市中，处于殖民教育与就业机会有利地位的圣公会新郎新娘的婚姻登记数据，考察了传教士学校教育及正规劳动力参与中性别不平等的殖民起源与演变。配偶的签名识字率及职业统计揭示了殖民早期在进入传教士学校和正规工作方面性别差距的扩大。正规工作中的性别差距远大于教育领域，于1930年代达到顶峰，随后迅速缩小，这得益于去殖民化进程中英国殖民公共服务的非洲化与女性化。在英属非洲各城市，女性对正规劳动的选择存在显著差异，大多数西非新娘从事非正规创收活动，而东非新娘则主要致力于家务。我们将这些区域差异归因于前殖民时期西非女性更强的经济自主性，这种自主性在传教士推广的维多利亚时代性别理想下依然得以延续。
title: Gender inequality in urban British Africa: Evidence from Anglican marriage registers
title_zh: 英属非洲城市中的性别不平等：来自圣公会婚姻登记的证据

abstract: We study how poor hand-to-mouth and wealthy hand-to-mouth households in the United States form their expectations as compared to unconstrained households. To do so, we use monthly household data for the period 2005:2 to 2013:6 with information on the exact survey day for each household within a month. Utilizing a timeline of financial crisis events along with changes in stock market values and uncertainty in the days around those events, we assess the response of these households' expectations regarding inflation, unemployment, and the interest rate. Our estimates imply differences in the formation of expectations for liquidity-constrained households relative to unconstrained households. Wealthy hand-to-mouth households tend to revise their inflation expectations downwards substantially so that they make lower forecast errors following adverse financial crisis events that lower the actual future inflation rate, while other households appear inattentive to these shocks. This suggests that the wealthy hand-to-mouth households decipher these financial events' noisy signal regarding lower future inflation more accurately than other households, in line with having a greater incentive to do so.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了美国贫困手口相济家庭与富裕手口相济家庭在形成预期时，相较于无约束家庭有何不同。为此，我们使用了2005年2月至2013年6月期间的月度家庭数据，其中包含每户家庭在月内具体调查日的信息。利用金融危机事件的时间线，以及这些事件前后几天内股市价值变化和不确定性，我们评估了这些家庭对通胀、失业率和利率预期的反应。我们的估计结果显示，流动性受限家庭与无约束家庭在预期形成上存在差异。富裕手口相济家庭倾向于大幅下调其通胀预期，从而在不利金融危机事件导致实际未来通胀率下降时，产生较低的预测误差，而其他家庭似乎对这些冲击不够关注。这表明，富裕手口相济家庭能比其他家庭更准确地解读这些金融事件中关于未来通胀下降的噪声信号，这与他们拥有更强的动机去这样做相符。
title: Understanding expectations formation for hand‐to‐mouth households: lessons from the financial crisis
title_zh: 理解手头拮据家庭的预期形成：金融危机的教训

abstract: Economists have long studied how parental behavior shapes within-family inequality, yet empirical findings remain mixed. Using twins data from China and Sweden, we examine the predominant mechanisms reported in the literature. Parents in both countries invest similarly during childhood. Inter vivos transfers, however, differ: Chinese parents reinforce income inequality, whereas Swedish parents distribute wealth equally; the reinforcing pattern reflects exchange motives. Bequests are divided equally in both countries. Parental education plays a key role: less educated parents reinforce income inequality, whereas more educated parents transfer wealth equally. Cross-country differences in parental education may thus help explain the mixed findings.
abstract_zh: 经济学家长期研究父母行为如何塑造家庭内部不平等，但实证结果仍不一致。利用中国和瑞典的双胞胎数据，我们考察了文献中报告的主要机制。两国的父母在子女童年时期的投资相似。然而，生前转移存在差异：中国父母加剧收入不平等，而瑞典父母则平均分配财富；这种加剧模式反映了交换动机。两国在遗产分配上均采取均分方式。父母教育水平起着关键作用：教育程度较低的父母加剧收入不平等，而教育程度较高的父母则平均转移财富。因此，跨国父母教育差异可能有助于解释这些不一致的研究发现。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Do Parents Propagate Inequality Among Children? Evidence From Chinese and Swedish Twins
title_zh: 父母是否在子女间传递不平等？来自中国和瑞典双胞胎的证据

abstract: This paper estimates the causal impact on vehicle prices of an automobile manufacturers’ cartel that operated in Spain from 2006 to 2013. To do so, we construct a novel dataset containing manufacturers’ recommended retail prices for Spain and several unaffected European Union countries over the period 2000–2011. Exploiting variation in the timing of cartel entry across brands, we apply a difference-in-differences approach controlling for sales volume, scrappage schemes, and fixed effects. Our estimates show that the cartel increased prices in Spain by approximately 9.3% on average during the infringement period. Robustness checks confirm the consistency of the findings: the parallel trends assumption holds, results remain stable with alternative control groups, and placebo tests yield no significant effects. These findings contribute to the limited empirical literature on causal estimation of cartel overcharges and provide policy-relevant insights on the transmission of upstream collusion to final consumer prices.
abstract_zh: 本文估计了2006年至2013年间在西班牙运营的一个汽车制造商卡特尔对车辆价格的因果影响。为此，我们构建了一个新颖的数据集，包含2000年至2011年间西班牙及多个未受影响的欧盟国家的制造商建议零售价。利用各品牌加入卡特尔的时间差异，我们采用双重差分法，并控制销量、报废补贴计划及固定效应。估计结果显示，在侵权期间，该卡特尔使西班牙的汽车价格平均上涨约9.3%。稳健性检验证实了研究结果的一致性：平行趋势假设成立，使用替代对照组时结果保持稳定，安慰剂检验未产生显著效应。这些发现为关于卡特尔超额收费因果估计的有限实证文献做出了贡献，并为上游合谋向最终消费者价格传导提供了政策相关的见解。
source_issue: International Journal of Industrial Organization, Volume 106
title: Causal evidence of antitrust damages in the car manufacturers’ cartel in Spain
title_zh: 西班牙汽车制造商卡特尔反垄断损害赔偿的因果证据

abstract: Are standard production network properties similar across all available datasets, and if not, why? We provide benchmark results from two administrative datasets (Ecuador and Hungary), which are exceptional in that they have no reporting threshold. We compare these networks with a leading commercial dataset (FactSet) and published results on national firm-level production networks. Administrative datasets with no reporting thresholds have remarkably similar quantitative properties, while a number of important properties are biased in datasets with missing data.
abstract_zh: 标准生产网络属性在所有可用数据集中是否相似？若否，原因何在？我们提供了来自两个行政数据集（厄瓜多尔和匈牙利）的基准结果，这些数据集因其无报告门槛而尤为特殊。我们将这些网络与领先的商业数据集（FactSet）及已发表的关于国家企业级生产网络的结果进行比较。无报告门槛的行政数据集在定量属性上表现出显著相似性，而含缺失数据的数据集中若干重要属性则存在偏差。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Firm-level production networks: What do we (really) know?
title_zh: 企业层面的生产网络：我们（真正）了解什么？

abstract: Measures of stock market volatility, such as the cross-sectional dispersion of firm-level stock returns and the time-series volatility of market returns, fluctuate countercyclically. While this phenomenon is often used as evidence that exogenous rises in uncertainty lead to economic recessions, we show that first-moment productivity shocks can cause countercyclical fluctuations in stock market volatility. We study a dynamic model with costly state verification, allowing for ex-ante monitoring that can credibly compel borrowers to reveal true investment outcomes to lenders, thereby reducing information asymmetry. Interpreting these financial contracts as external equities, we show that the calibrated model, with only first-moment shocks, can generate cyclical fluctuations in equity return volatility and financial conditions, with correlation coefficients between pairs of these measures quantitatively in line with the data.
abstract_zh: 股票市场波动性的度量指标，如公司层面股票收益的横截面离散度和市场收益的时间序列波动性，呈现出逆周期波动。尽管这一现象常被用作外生不确定性上升导致经济衰退的证据，但我们表明，一阶矩生产率冲击能够引发股票市场波动性的逆周期波动。我们研究了一个带有昂贵状态验证的动态模型，允许事前监督，这种监督能够可信地迫使借款人向贷款人揭示真实投资结果，从而减少信息不对称。将这些金融合约解释为外部股权，我们表明，仅含一阶矩冲击的校准模型能够生成股权收益波动性和金融状况的周期性波动，且这些度量指标之间的相关系数在数量上与数据相符。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: Endogenous dispersion and volatility in stock returns
title_zh: 股票收益的内生离散度与波动性
